title: Trellis machine-local model roster
description: Owner-local routing configuration, not portable policy. The loader checks ownership and file mode (0600 in a 0700 parent). The resolver checks catalog references, allowed efforts, capabilities, and independence rules; this file cannot override them. Store credential references, never credentials or probe output.

routes.description: Seat aliases mapped to routes in preference order. Omit a seat that is not on this machine. Seat aliases must resolve to portable seats or classified local seats.

local_models.description: Operator-classified extra model IDs. They may not shadow portable models or seats, and IDs that do not identify a fixed model (such as auto) cannot be classified.

role_extensions.description: Existing portable role IDs mapped to append-only extensions. The resolver checks role/seat references and keeps portable ordering, restrictions and independence rules.

credentialRef.description: Credential location only: pi-auth:<provider>, env:<VAR>, or keychain:<service>. Never a key value.

authProbe.description: Noninteractive command as argv, including its executable, run without a shell. Arguments must not contain credentials, and output must stay out of logs and receipts.

verdict_host.description: Set false on a worker that must not decide verdict roles locally.

at.description: Timezone-qualified generation timestamp; calendar validity is a consumer check.

route.description: A direct provider, a named pool, or a non-Pi harness's default provider. Pool names must exist. The resolver checks adapter support and model identity; omitting native_model uses the catalog model ID.

metered.description: Operator assertion; omit for a metered route.

live_probe.description: Require an exact live listing before selection; the adapter must support it.

confirmed.description: False marks a provisional route that still needs operator confirmation.

env_only.description: Route is visible with inherited environment variables but not in a minimal environment.

opportunistic.description: Overflow only; cannot cast a deciding vote.

verified_flags.description: Whether the harness flags needed by this route have been verified on this host.

fleets.description: When present, only these fleets may use the route, subject to the fleet's own allow/deny rules.

quota.description: Quota source and optional report lookup key. The resolver must not infer headroom for a metered route from none or missing telemetry.

pool.description: Member IDs and provider IDs must be unique within a pool. Confirm distinct billing accounts before relying on members as independent capacity; array uniqueness alone cannot check that.

account.description: Billing workspace/account identity for selection and latches, not a credential. Omit if unknown to use the member ID provisionally. <probe> is an unverified marker, not evidence of a distinct workspace.

key_sha256_10.description: Lowercase ten-hex SHA-256 prefix of the key, used to invalidate stale latches after key rotation. May be omitted for provisional members and fixtures.

seats.description: When present, restrict this member to these seat aliases. If absent, the member serves every seat routed through this pool.

fleetSelector.description: Wildcard or a list of seat, harness, or provider IDs.

fleet.description: Fleet fence applied in addition to any route fleets restriction. Denial takes precedence, including a matching pool in deny_pools.

until.description: Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); the resolver checks calendar validity.

fallback_for.description: Must name a different seat already present earlier in the combined chain.
